all.sourceText:
## Warren Ashford — City Council District 7

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-council-d7/`
- **Address:** Sign off on the fire-rated wall inspections and drywall milestone for the Temescal Community Health Center (INIT-005) while addressing KONO district sentiment distress.
- **Why:** Following C107 MEP rough-in completion, INIT-005 requires C108 drywall inspection approvals; simultaneously, KONO records the lowest sentiment in Oakland (0.17 vs city 0.330, CrimeIndex 0.61).
- **Acceptance:** Transmittal of the certified fire-rated wall inspection sign-off and a municipal service request targeting KONO corridor safety.
- **Silence consequence:** Construction crews stall prior to interior enclosure, delaying the operational handover of the Temescal facility.

all.sourceText:
## Warren Ashford — City Council District 7

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-council-d7/`
- **Address:** Submit the certified fire-rated wall and drywall inspection sign-off for the Temescal Community Health Center (INIT-005).
- **Why:** Following C108 MEP verification, INIT-005 is scheduled for drywall installation and certified wall inspection sign-offs in C109, with the project board facing a C110 stall clock.
- **Acceptance:** Transmittal of the certified building inspection sign-off and drywall authorization for the Temescal facility to the Planning and Building Department.
- **Silence consequence:** Interior enclosure work on the Temescal facility stops, causing construction delays that compromise the facility's operational delivery schedule.
